title: Gusinzira kw'abakiranutsi
intro: Mu gihe ukwizera kwari guteye akaga kandi abanyambaraga bashakaga gusenya ukwemera, itsinda rito ry’abantu bakiri bato ryahisemo ibintu byagiye bigaruka mu bihe bitandukanye. Bahunze ibyo bari bazi byose, bashakira ubuhungiro mu mwijima wihishe w’umusozi kandi biringira Imana byuzuye. Ibyakurikiyeho byari kuba ikimenyetso kidashira ku batekereza.
clues: Twari itsinda ry'urubyiruko rwizeraga Umwami wacu, kandi yatwongereye ubuyobozi.
Twahagaze imbere y'abantu bacu maze dutangaza ko tutazigera dusenga indi mana uretse Allah.
Twashatse ubuhungiro mu buvumo, tuti: 'Mwami wacu, duhe imbabazi zituruka kuri wowe kandi utuyobore neza mu byo dukora.'
Twasinziriye imyaka myinshi, izuba ryavaga mu buvumo bwacu ntiridukoreho.
Imbwa yacu yari iryamye ku muryango w'ubuvumo, iraturinda nk'aho iri maso.
Ubwo twakangutse, twibajije igihe twari tumaze dutegereje, maze umwe muri twe atumwa n'ibiceri by'ifeza kugura ibyo kurya.
